title: Delegation refresh for a child session holds the state lock ~330 ms across lookup, wait refresh and commit housekeeping
outcome: refresh_delegation_for_child_session (delegations.rs:~1748) does only the minimal mutation under StateInner (indexed lookup, the lifecycle delta, the exact persisted delta), without a linear delegation scan, a refresh of ALL waits, or full commit housekeeping, and without simply moving commit_locked after unlock.
acceptance: Under the state lock, a child-session delegation refresh finds its delegation without a linear scan, refreshes only the waits it can affect, and persists through the existing exact persisted-delta commit path; it does not run full commit housekeeping or the global snapshot capture for this change, and commit_locked is not simply moved after the lock is released.

Tests show delegation lifecycle deltas, wait refresh results, detached-child runtime handling and persisted state are equal to the current implementation's for representative cases, including boot and lifecycle callers, and that ordering relative to concurrent commits is unchanged.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree.

completion.summary: Historical delivered work reconciled; 7f122638; exact Mac FULL/pair and push ef95429c recorded; remaining acceptance/evidence accounting, no new delegation-refresh implementation.
